verdict.rationale: Cekura documents first-party cron jobs that run automated calls on a schedule, check agent status, and alert you when things fail (cekura-docs-13, cekura-docs-62). It also polls Retell call data every 30 seconds with no user action (cekura-docs-58) and claims ongoing live drift detection plus automatic flag→reproduce→suggest-fix loops (cekura-docs-20, cekura-docs-21). Missing for 10: detail on what cron jobs can trigger beyond test calls (e.g., evaluations or chained actions), configurability of alert channels, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the background automations work as claimed.
